issues.description: The proposal hallucinates a specific name, 'Rajiv Mehta', for the Head of Compliance, which is not provided in the Client Matrix.
issues.suggested_fix: Remove the fabricated name and refer simply to the 'Head of Compliance' or 'compliance team'.

issues.description: The proposal explicitly names stakeholders (Rita, Sarah, Marcus) and bluntly describes their internal conflicts and disagreements. Exposing internal politics in a client-facing document is highly unprofessional and risks embarrassing the firm and alienating the client.
issues.suggested_fix: Rewrite these open questions to diplomatically request alignment on budget, timeline, and strategy without naming specific individuals or explicitly stating that they are in conflict.

issues.description: The proposed timeline hardcodes a 16-week schedule, which likely pushes the pilot into Q4. This inadvertently takes a side in the unresolved Q3 vs Q4 pilot deadline conflict before the alignment discussion occurs.
issues.suggested_fix: Add a disclaimer that the timeline is illustrative and will be finalized once the target pilot timeline (Q3 vs Q4) is aligned upon during kickoff.

risks: The proposal lacks diplomatic tact in addressing contradicted items, risking severe client alienation by airing their internal political disagreements in a formal document.
Hallucinating stakeholder names damages the firm's credibility and attention to detail.
